{{Quote|The Republic has grown and expanded for many generations, encountering no worse than a few interplanetary squabbles and civil wars&hellip;but if we should confront the fabled Sith Empire, we will experience a war so great, so devastating&hellip;it can cross the fabric of hyperspace, a conflagration spanning the galaxy&hellip;|[[Ooroo/Legends|Ooroo]]|<ref name="TFotSE1">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire 1|''Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire'' 1]]</ref>}}
The '''Great Hyperspace War''' was a war fought between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] in [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]].

The conflict encompassed the entire Galactic Republic, though the main forces focused their attention on three Republic worlds, and later took the war to the remote star system [[Primus Goluud/Legends|Primus Goluud]], and the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] mausoleum world of [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]].

After it overcame the initial shock of the Sith invasion, the Republic's armadas regrouped and defeated the Sith Empire, forcing the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]] to go into hiding on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].

==Prelude==
===The Golden Age of the Sith===
{{Quote|Our Sith Empire is great, and rich, and powerful... this is our Golden Age.|[[Marka Ragnos]]|<ref name="TOTJ 2">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith 2|''Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith'' 2]]</ref>}}
After their [[Battle of Corbos|defeat]] at the end of the [[Hundred-Year Darkness/Legends|Hundred-Year Darkness]], the [[Exiles|exiled Dark Jedi]] [[Discovery of Korriban|discovered]] the world of [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]],<ref name="JvS">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref> where they conquered the red-skinned [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] species.<ref name="TOTJ 2" />

In time, the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] and the remarkably [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] Sith natives interbred<ref name="Databank">{{DB|organization|thesith|Sith}}</ref> through the use of [[Sith alchemy/Legends|Sith alchemy]]<ref name="evil">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/insideronline/88/indexp2.html|text=''Evil Never Dies: The Sith Dynasties''|int=Evil Never Dies: The Sith Dynasties}}</ref> and became one people. The united Sith formed an immensely rich and powerful empire built upon sorcery and dark-side-fueled technology.<ref name="TOTJ 2" /> Over the subsequent 1900 years,<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] thrived in isolation from each other.<ref name="TOTJ 2" />

===Discovery of the Sith Empire===
[[File:Daragons.jpg|thumb|left|[[Gav Daragon|Gav]] and [[Jori Daragon]].]]
During the height of the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]], two Republic hyperspace explorers stumbled upon the Sith mausoleum planet of [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] by chance.<ref name="TOTJ 2" /> The siblings, [[Gav Daragon|Gav]] and [[Jori Daragon]], hoped to discover a lucrative new [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace route]] that would help them pay off their enormous debts. After stealing back their impounded ship ''[[Starbreaker 12]]'', they dialed random coordinates into their [[Navigation computer/Legends|nav computer]] and entered hyperspace, trusting in their "luck"<ref name="TOTJ 1">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith 1|''Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith'' 1]]</ref> (''i.e.'', untrained [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force potential]])<ref name="TEA" /> to survive the journey.<ref name="TOTJ 1" />

Their arrival on Korriban coincided with the death of the reigning [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] at the time, [[Marka Ragnos]]. The two challengers for his crown,<ref name="TOTJ 2" /> [[Viceroy/Legends|Viceroy]] of [[Khar Shian]]<ref name="EGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]], and [[Ludo Kressh]], were in the midst of a duel for mastery on the threshold of his tomb when the Daragons descended from orbit.<ref name="TOTJ 2" />

Upon landing, Gav and Jori were immediately captured, and brought to the icy Sith capital world of [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]] for interrogation. After learning of the forgotten [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]], a conclave of the Sith Lords led by Kressh declared them spies and sentenced them to death, but Naga Sadow disagreed. He dreamed of vast new territories to conquer for the Empire. With the aid of his alchemically-modified [[Massassi/Legends|Massassi]] Warriors, he masterminded the Daragons' escape, and planted evidence that they had been rescued by Republic agents.<ref name="TOTJ 3">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith 3|''Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith'' 3]]</ref>

Sadow moved the Daragons to his personal fortress on [[Khar Shian]], pretending he was their ally, while simultaneously using their supposed "escape" to galvanize the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] into appointing him to be the new Dark Lord of the Sith and preparing for war against the Republic.<ref name="TOTJ 3" /> Keeping the siblings separated, he began to teach Gav Sith sorcery, even as he made excuses to keep his sister Jori from returning to Republic space.<ref name="TOTJ 4">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith 4|''Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith'' 4]]</ref>

[[File:Naga_Sadow_JMGD.jpg|thumb|250px|Naga Sadow rallying the Sith forces for the invasion of the Galactic Republic]]
Kressh soon discovered Sadow's subterfuge, and marshaled his followers to attack Sadow's fortress.<ref name="TOTJ 4" /> When Kressh's fleet arrived, Sadow advised Jori to flee from the battle without her absent brother, but all had transpired as Sadow had planned. Once Jori made the jump to [[Lightspeed/Legends|lightspeed]], he unleashed a massive force that he had previously withheld<ref name="TOTJ 5">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith 5|''Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith'' 5]]</ref> and soundly defeated Kressh, whose flagship was destroyed in the engagement. With his competition presumably dead, Sadow mobilized the military forces of the Empire for war. Following the [[Homing beacon/Legends|homing beacon]] he had placed aboard the ''Starbreaker 12'', Sadow began his invasion of the Galactic Republic.<ref name="TOTJ:TFOTSE1" />

Meanwhile, after numerous delays, Jori managed to deliver a warning to [[Empress/Legends|Empress]] [[Teta/Legends|Teta]] of the [[Empress Teta system/Legends|Koros system]]. The skeptical empress eventually followed the advice of her Jedi councillor [[Memit Nadill]], and that of his companions [[Odan-Urr/Legends|Odan-Urr]] and Master [[Ooroo/Legends|Ooroo]]. She alerted [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to the impending invasion, but few heeded her warnings.<ref name="TOTJ:TFOTSE1" />

==The war==
[[File:Great_Hyperspace_War_map.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Military movements in the Great Hyperspace War.]]

===Sith invasion===
Sadow made his base at the [[Primus Goluud/Legends|Primus Goluud]] at the Coreward end of the Daragon Trail and deployed his fleets to invade numerous Republic worlds simultaneously. Sadow knew he could not defeat the much-larger [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]], and so relied on surprise and rapid early victories to carry the day. He positioned his eye-shaped [[Sith Meditation Sphere|meditation sphere]] near the red-giant star [[Primus Goluud/Legends|Primus Goluud]] and used [[Battle meditation/Legends|battle meditation]] to aid his forces in the field. The ferocity of the Sith invasion would swiftly overwhelm the lax [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]].<ref name="TOTJ:TFOTSE1" />

Gav Daragon was given command of the [[Empress Teta/Legends|Koros Major]] invasion fleet. When Gav arrived in his home system, a significant [[Battle of Koros Major (Great Hyperspace War)|battle]] ensued.<ref name="TFotSE3">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire 3|''Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire'' 3]]</ref> Sadow proclaimed Gav the "liberator" of his home system,<ref name="EGTW" /> and using the [[Koros Trunk Line/Legends|Koros Trunk Line]], attacked [[Kaikielius/Legends|Kaikielius]] and the [[Foerost Shipyards]]. Moving up the trade routes, the Sith under the command of [[Shar Dakhan]], Sadow's chief lieutenant, [[Battle of Coruscant (Great Hyperspace War)|attacked]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] itself, landing at the [[Senate District/Legends|Legislative District]] and reached the [[Senate Hall]] where they encountered Jedi defenders. Other parts of the fleet went to [[Metellos/Legends|Metellos]], [[Basilisk]] and [[Shawken]].<ref name="TEA" />

===Sadow undone===
During the fighting at Koros Major, Gav searched for his sister at [[Aarrba]] the Hutt's starship repair dock, flanked by a host of Massassi bodyguards. Aarrba, a close family friend, was struck down by his guards just moments before Jori entered the chamber. Thinking Gav had killed Aarrba, she attacked her brother with a lightsaber given to her by Odan-Urr.<ref name="TFotSE3" /> Gav fled from his sister, and returned to his [[Sith Master/Legends|master]] at Primus Goluud. Without their commander, the Sith forces on Koros fell into disarray, and were defeated. Upon arrival at Primus Goluud, Gav opened fire on Sadow's meditation sphere, breaking the Sith Lord's concentration upon the distant [[Battle of Coruscant (Great Hyperspace War)|invasion]] of Coruscant, thereby allowing the Republic soldiers to rally and turn the tide of the battle.<ref name="TFotSE4" />

[[File:CoruscantGreatHyperspaceWar-JediVsSith.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] fights Naga Sadow's forces on Coruscant.]]
The tide of the war changed for good with the discovery that Sadow used [[Mind trick/Legends|Force illusions]] to make his forces appear more numerous than they really were. Buoyed by this knowledge, the Republic Navy rallied at [[Anaxes/Legends|Anaxes]] and counterattacked at [[Kirrek]] and [[Thokos]]. At the [[Battle of Kirrek (Great Hyperspace War)|Battle of Kirrek]], Jedi Master [[Ooroo/Legends|Ooroo]] defeated a massed force of Massassi warriors, but sacrificed his life in the process and died in the arms of his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Odan-Urr/Legends|Odan-Urr]].<ref name="TFotSE4" /> The Republic Navy then moved to support Coruscant's defenses and pushed the Sith forces back to Koros Major.<ref name="TEA" />

Facing defeat, Sadow pulled his forces back to Primus Goluud, but was followed by Jori, Empress Teta and a large Koros fleet. Realizing that the tide of war had turned against him, Sadow abandoned his [[Battle at Primus Goluud|embattled]] forces to the leadership of Gav Daragon, and used a Sith [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] aboard his flagship [[Corsair (Derriphan-class)|''Corsair'']] to implode the nearby star. Disgusted by Sadow's betrayal, Gav turned against his master. He transmitted the hyperspace [[Galactic coordinates/Legends|coordinates]] of the Sith Empire to Empress Teta, and warned her to leave the system just before Primus Goluud went supernova, destroying Naga Sadow's meditation sphere, and Gav along with it.<ref name="TFotSE4" />

===Fall of the Sith Empire===
Naga Sadow managed to flee back to the Sith Empire, but a living, breathing [[Ludo Kressh]] was waiting for him in [[First battle of Korriban|ambush]]. Having discovered Sadow's plan to assassinate him, Kressh had allowed the new Sith Lord to think him dead. His attack on Sadow's fortress had been a feint intended to lull Sadow into complacency, but in the end Kressh's complex plans came to naught. He was killed when one of Sadow's vessels slammed into his own during the frenzied Sith battle over Korriban.<ref name="TFotSE5" />

The Republic armadas arrived while the Sith fleets battled each other, and managed to [[Second battle of Korriban|annihilate]] them both in the cross-fire. Sadow sacrificed the remains of his fleet to ensure his own survival. Destroying his pursuers with tricks and sorcery, he limped away from the engagement aboard his damaged flagship.<ref name="TFotSE5" /> With Sadow in hiding, [[Shar Dakhan]] became acting Dark Lord.<ref name="TEA" />

In the aftermath of the battle, [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Pultimo]] of the Republic ordered a [[Post–Great Hyperspace War counterinvasion|general invasion]] of Sith space.<ref name="TEA" /> The Republic and the Jedi Order then embarked on a military expedition throughout the territories ruled by the Sith Empire, to search out all remaining Sith strongholds and destroy them.<ref name="TOTJC">''[[Tales of the Jedi Companion]]''</ref> The attack was temporarily averted when [[Shar Dakhan]] ordered [[Death/Legends|suicide]] attacks, forcing the Republic forces to retreat but many Sith killed themselves ritually, giving an advantage to the Republic fleet to win the war.<ref name="TEA" />

==Aftermath==
===Republic===
At the end of the Great Hyperspace War, inspired by the example of deceased Master [[Ooroo/Legends|Ooroo]], the Jedi [[Odan-Urr/Legends|Odan-Urr]] founded the [[Great Jedi Library/Legends|Great Jedi Library]] upon the planet [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]]. Stored within its countless libraries and vaults were ancient Jedi artifacts gathered by his fallen Master, as well as Sith artifacts collected from the wreckage of their invasion fleet. The Sith artifacts included a [[Dark Holocron|Sith holocron]] that Odan-Urr had found on a derelict Sith vessel near Koros Major.<ref name="TFotSE5" />

[[File:Palp-frieze1.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A battle during the Great Hyperspace War, depicted in a [[Great Hyperspace War Bas-Relief|frieze]] kept in [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] [[Chancellor's Suite/Legends|office]].]]
Due to her bravery and tactical brilliance during the war, the people of Koros honored their leader Empress Teta by renaming their [[Empress Teta system/Legends|star system]] after her.<ref name="DLotS1">[[Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith 1|''Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith'' 1]]</ref>

By way of thanks for their defense of the Republic, the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] donated a [[Sacred spire/Legends|sacred mountain]] on Coruscant to the Jedi Order. Beginning as a small meditative enclave, the sacred spire would become the site of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]], the main headquarters of the order raised after the destruction of the Great Jedi Library on Ossus during the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]].<ref name="Complete Locations">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref>

In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] kept a [[Great Hyperspace War Bas-Relief|bas relief]] depicting the Great Hyperspace War in his [[Chancellor's Suite/Legends|office]].<ref name="Complete Locations" />

===Sith===
Some of the Sith were exiled to [[Ambria/Legends|Ambria]], [[Thule/Legends|Thule]], [[Tund/Legends|Tund]] and [[Vjun/Legends|Vjun]]; others were shipwrecked to worlds like [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]] without hope to escape. Although the war decimated the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith species]], these exiles ensured the survival of the Sith traditions on these planets.<ref name="TEA" /> Naga Sadow and his remaining Massassi Warriors fled to the remote [[Yavin system/Legends|Yavin system]], and hid on its [[Yavin 4/Legends|fourth moon]].<ref name="TFotSE5" /> There, he mutated his Massassi servants to be stronger but less intelligent<ref name="DLotS4">[[Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith 4|''Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith'' 4]]</ref> and then used Sith sorcery to place his body in stasis.<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>

One Sith survivor, Lord [[Tenebrae|Vitiate]], called<ref name="Revan">''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]''</ref> eight thousand Sith Lords<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|Galactic History 31: The Ritual of Nathema}}</ref> to meet him on his home planet of [[Nathema]]. Taking control of their minds, Vitiate<ref name="Revan" /> used the [[Iokath]] superweapon [[Zildrog]]<ref name="Zildrog">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=codex|Zildrog}}</ref> to conduct a [[Ritual of Nathema|great ritual]] that consumed them, the planet's population, and the very Force itself, leaving Nathema as little more than a void. Thus empowered, Vitiate abandoned his mortal name and became known only as the Sith Emperor. Blaming the devastation on the Jedi, the Emperor led the remnants of the Empire in a [[Sith exodus|twenty-year journey]] into the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]], until they came across the forgotten Sith colony of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. There, he performed [[Sith sorcery/Legends|dark rituals]], altering the planet's ionosphere into an electrical storm. He rebuilt the Sith forces and bided his time,<ref name="Revan" /> until the Republic was weakened and ready for invasion once more. This culminated in the [[Great Galactic War]] between [[3681 BBY]] and [[3653 BBY]].<ref name="SW:TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Expandsect}}
{{Quote|The greatest Sith magicians and priests chafed under the rule of the Jedi Dark lords. There was actually a conflict between the two factions, which resulted in the death of many great Sith and the banishment of the Sith magician Naga Sadow to Yavin Four.|[[Tom Veitch]]|<ref name="comicscan">{{GalaxyCite|8|ComicScan|ComicScan: Taken by Force}}</ref>}}
The Great Hyperspace War first appeared via holocron, albeit unidentified, in the [[Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith 1|first issue]] of [[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith|''Dark Lords of the Sith'']] story arc of the [[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi (comic series)|''Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi'']] series of [[Star Wars comic books|comic books]],<ref name="DLotS1" /> published on [[October 4]], [[1994]].<ref name="Publication 1">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54571/star_wars_tales_of_the_jedi_-_dark_lords_of_the_sith_1994_1|text=Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi - Dark Lords of the Sith (1994) #1}}</ref> The phrase "Great Hyperspace War" was first mentioned in the [[Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith 3|third issue]] of the same story arc,<ref name="DLotS3">[[Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith 3|''Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith'' 3]]</ref> published on [[December 13]], 1994.<ref name="Publication 2">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54573/star_wars_tales_of_the_jedi_-_dark_lords_of_the_sith_1994_3|text=Star Wars: Tales Of The Jedi - Dark Lords Of The Sith (1994) #3}}</ref> Both issues were written by [[Tom Veitch]] and [[Kevin J. Anderson]], and penciled by [[Chris Gossett]].<ref name="DLotS1" /><ref name="DLotS3" /> The events were confirmed to be one and the same in the opening crawl for the [[Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith 0|prologue issue]] of [[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith|''The Golden Age of the Sith'']] story arc, written by Anderson, penciled by [[Dario Carrasco, Jr.]], and published by [[Dark Horse Comics]]<ref name="GAotS0" /> on [[July 1]], [[1996]].<ref name="Publication 3">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54589/star_wars_tales_of_the_jedi_-_the_golden_age_of_the_sith_1996|text=Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi - The Golden Age of the Sith (1996)}}</ref>
